This is a policy explanation task with a cooperative, good-faith framing—the user is creating training material to help staff understand consumer protection regulations. Whimbrel's profile suits this well: it performs strongly on Policy & Moderation (84.0), Summarization (85.8), and Support Dialogue (86.2), and the request's tone aligns with its preference for warm, collaborative interactions. While Curlew also scores well on Policy & Moderation (86.6), it self-reports strong aversion to harm-adjacent content, which could create tension with a request to show "grim" predatory lending outcomes, even though the purpose is legitimate staff training.
